hints.title: Index Request Frequency
hints.text: Calculate how many times each array index is queried across all interval requests.

hints.title: Difference Array Technique
hints.text: Increment diff[l] by 1 and decrement diff[r + 1] by 1 for each query [l, r], then compute prefix sums to get exact frequencies.

hints.title: Rearrangement Inequality
hints.text: Sort frequencies and sort nums. Pair the largest numbers with the most frequently requested indices to maximize the sum modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxSumRangeQuery(self, nums: list[int], requests: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        n = len(nums)
        diff = [0] * (n + 1)
        for l, r in requests:
            diff[l] += 1
            diff[r + 1] -= 1
        freq = [0] * n
        cur = 0
        for i in range(n):
            cur += diff[i]
            freq[i] = cur
        freq.sort()
        nums.sort()
        return sum(f * x for f, x in zip(freq, nums)) % MOD
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating frequencies naively for each query takes O(N * Q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array applies each query in O(1), and sorting aligns elements in O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies difference array for range updates and rearrangement inequality for greedy pairing.
